The first PRs after adoption show the round cap and step-back working, linked as evidence.

Consumer activation also owns the relock evidence transferred from theseus-body-only-finding-cannot-be-adjudicated-20261106: BenchBox pins a released Theseus artifact containing the merged threadless-dispute fix and its end-to-end scenario (first released in v0.2.7; BenchBox is locked to v0.2.9, so satisfied), and exact-head hosted dispute/escalation/adjudication and gate evidence is recorded.

description:
Adopt the Theseus review settings that BenchBox's current lock supports, in one PR (open as BenchBox #4118 'feat(review): adopt the classifier fallback, size floor and review guidance'):
- `.github/review-guidance.md` (D3: repository failure modes plus a do-not-flag list covering the no-docstring policy and changelog fragments), registered in classifier.gate_paths and the soundness manifest;
- policy keys `protocol.max_finding_rounds: 4` and `brief.include_intent: true` (plus the classifier fallback and size floor);
- the weekly live eval schedule (not in #4118; separate step).
The pre-existing policy is no longer part of this item: Theseus now treats every finding as blocking (#54), and the known-defects mechanism is tracked in theseus-known-defects-pre-existing-20261109.
The lock-only promotions are separate items: v0.2.10 (benchbox-lock-theseus-review-format-release-a-20261110, PR #4123) and v0.2.11 (benchbox-lock-theseus-review-format-release-b-20261110).
D10: the human step stays an owner instruction recorded for audit. D11: no separate owner-attention list, because the soundness manifest covers those paths. Revisit both if a second human reviewer joins.
